emotional_tone: Premium, data-dense, confident, high-frequency trading terminal feel

spacing_and_layout.surface_style: Grid Borders (Technical look). 1px solid borders, no soft shadows. Sharp corners (rounded-sm or rounded-none).
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-aligned strictly for data tables and dense content.
spacing_and_layout.button_style: Flat, 1px border, rectangular. Active state: bg-amber-500 text-black.

components.navigation: Left sidebar for dashboard with visible grid lines. High contrast amber indicator for active tab.
components.tables: Dense rows, monospace fonts for all numerical data and dates (IBM Plex Mono). 1px bottom border for rows. Use tabular-nums utility.
components.cards: Flat background (#13161A), 1px solid border (#27272A), sharp corners. No shadow.
components.status_badges: Minimalist. For ACTIVE: text-[#00A25B] bg-[#00A25B]/10 border border-[#00A25B]/20. For EXPIRED: text-[#E92C2C] bg-[#E92C2C]/10 border border-[#E92C2C]/20.
components.inputs: Shadcn inputs with custom styling: bg-transparent, border-gray-800, focus:border-amber-500, focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500.
components.charts_kpis: Value in large monospace font. Small subtitle in uppercase IBM Plex Sans. Use step-up surface colors for elevation.

motion.hover_states: Crisp transitions. Borders light up (e.g., border-amber-500) on hover instead of shadow lift.
motion.page_transitions: Instant or subtle 150ms fade. Power-user tools shouldn't have slow animations.

images.description: Dark stock market trading chart. Use with a heavy dark overlay (bg-black/80) to ensure text readability.

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet WCAG AA standards. Ensure amber (#F58220) and green (#00A25B) have enough contrast against #0A0A0A.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply a global dark theme by default (no light mode toggle required as this is a terminal-inspired tool).
Use Chivo for headings, IBM Plex Sans for body, and IBM Plex Mono for all numerical data, amounts, and dates in the dashboard.
For the Landing Page: Implement an asymmetric split layout. Left side: value proposition with the chart image background (heavy dark overlay). Right side: clean, high-contrast checkout card.
For the Dashboard: Build a dense 'Control Room' grid layout. Avoid heavy paddings inside data tables; maximize screen real estate.
Use sharp corners (rounded-sm or none) for all Shadcn components (cards, buttons, inputs) to match the technical trading vibe.
Add 'tabular-nums' class to all numerical data cells.
